versions.changelog:
FUTA Express package tracking skill initial release.

- Enables tracking of FUTA Express (Phương Trang) deliveries using their public API.
- Extracts tracking code from user input and provides detailed配送 status, sender/receiver info, fees, and shipment history.
- Presents all response data in Vietnamese, preserving original wording and formats.
- Includes clear error handling for missing or invalid tracking codes.
- Displays results in a structured, user-friendly format with support for multiple packages and service details.
